texts.MauvilleCity_Text_NurseHurtMonBackToHeal: You know, it's cool to have POKéMON\nbattles and stuff…\pBut if your POKéMON gets hurt,\nyou have to nurse it back to health.$

texts.MauvilleCity_Text_PokemonCanJumpYouOnBik: Even if you're riding a BIKE,\nwild POKéMON could jump you.$

texts.MauvilleCity_Text_AllSortsOfPeopleComeTh: The roads of this town stretch north\nand south, and east and west.\pBecause of that, we get all sorts of\npeople coming through.$

texts.MauvilleCity_Text_RydelVeryGenerous: Have you been to RYDEL'S CYCLES yet?\pRYDEL, the owner, is a very generous\nman.$

texts.MauvilleCity_Text_ExplainTV:
Hi, do you check out TV at all?\pThey've added a bunch of cool new
shows recently.\pTV is so cool. I've seen my friends on
TV just out of the blue.\pAnd, sometimes, they even put you on TV
without telling you.\pI wish I would be on TV sometime.\pThat's why I think you should check
out TVs whenever you can.$

texts.MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWantToChallengeGy: WALLY: Aww, UNCLE, please?\pI want to challenge this GYM and see\nhow much better I've become.\pPlease? May I, please?$
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_UncleYourePushingIt: UNCLE: Now hold on, WALLY.\pSince you started living with POKéMON,\nyou have grown quite a lot stronger.\pBut don't you think you're pushing it\nto suddenly challenge a GYM?$
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWeCanBeatAnyone: WALLY: I'm not pushing it.\pIf I combine forces with RALTS,\nwe can beat anyone!$
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWillYouBattleMe:
WALLY: Oh! Hi, {PLAYER}!\pI've gotten a lot stronger since
we met.\p{PLAYER}, I want you and my UNCLE to
understand that.\p{PLAYER}, please, will you have
a battle with me?$

texts.MauvilleCity_Text_UncleHesTooPeppy: UNCLE: It's because of POKéMON that\nthis boy's got more pep, I suppose…\lBut he's become a bit too peppy…$

texts.MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonNeedFavorTakeKe:
WATTSON: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
You look like you have a lot of zip!\lThat's a good thing, wahahahaha!\pFine! I've decided!
I need a favor, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pMAUVILLE CITY has an underground
sector called NEW MAUVILLE.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I'd like you to go there and
switch off the GENERATOR.\pThe GENERATOR has been running a bit
haywire. It's getting unsafe.\pHere, this is the KEY to get into
NEW MAUVILLE.$
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonWontBeChallenge:
WATTSON: Don't you worry about it.
It won't be a challenge to you.\pThe entrance to NEW MAUVILLE is just
a short SURF away from ROUTE 110.\pThat's it, then, you have my trust!
Wahahahaha!$

texts.MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTeach:
Did you know that you can go from
here a long way in that direction\lwithout changing direction?\pI might even be able to roll
that way.\pDo you think your POKéMON will
want to roll, too?\pI can teach one the move ROLLOUT
if you'd like.$
texts.MoveTutor_Text_RolloutWhichMon: Ehehe, sure thing! It'd be great if\nthe POKéMON looked like me.$

texts.MauvilleCity_Text_GymSign: MAUVILLE CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: WATTSON\l“The cheerfully electrifying man!”$

texts.MauvilleCity_Text_CitySign: MAUVILLE CITY\n“The bright and shiny city of fun!”$

texts.MauvilleCity_Text_BikeShopSign: “Ride in gravel and shake up your\nsoul!”\lRYDEL'S CYCLES$

texts.MauvilleCity_Text_GameCornerSign: “The play spot for all!”\nMAUVILLE GAME CORNER$
